prior_importants.description: The PR drops `--literal-pathspecs` and switches to inline pathspec magic, `` `:(top,literal)${path}` ``. The env var `GIT_LITERAL_PATHSPECS=1` turns off magic parsing completely, and `scrubbedGitEnv` does not remove it. So when pup's own environment carries it, `git diff -U0 target...branch -- ':(top,literal)src/a.ts'` looks for a file literally named `:(top,literal)src/a.ts`. That matches nothing, and `gitDiffAddedLines` returns `{}`. The same root cause reaches the new `':(top)'` pathspec in `filesNaming`, whose grep then lists no importers.

findings.description: A branch that only deletes a real binary of a format outside BINARY_FORMATS (a .pdf, .gif, .woff2, .webp, .zip), or a PNG/JPEG over 1 MiB, now recounts its newline bytes as deleted source lines and names the file in `forged`. Before this PR it answered null. Nothing reaches the tree, so this is a false forged flag, and the bogus count can also trip the oversize flag.

`scrubbedGitEnv` lets `GIT_DIFF_OPTS` through, and git documents that it overrides the `-U0` that `diffHunks` pins. If the operator exports `GIT_DIFF_OPTS=--unified=3`, `gitDiffAddedLines` reports unchanged context lines as added. That dilutes `patchCoverage`'s ratio and can pass a coverage gate that should fail. Adding `'GIT_DIFF_OPTS'` to the scrub list closes it, the same way 4da30ce closed the pathspec-mode variables.

process_issues.description: Round 4 importants-only budget: conventions, docs, context, simplicity and maintainability were skipped. Spec was skipped because there is no closing issue or --spec source, and workflow-safety because no .github/workflows file changed. Correctness and security each ran two instances because the diff has 1874 added lines across src/ and docs/. Reviewers also reported three minors that were not recorded under the round-4 budget: rawDiffEntries passes --no-relative twice (L256 and L262); ADR 0154 L172-173 names ls-tree where blobSize uses cat-file -s; and the guards reviewer did not read every candidate guard test (land.test.ts, overlap.test.ts).
